    Source: 'src/reference.rs', lines 44:0-50:1
    Visibility: public -/
def reference.leaf_step
  (s : reference.Scratch) (index : Std.U32) (leaf : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result (Option reference.Scratch)
  := do
  if s.n > 0#usize
  then
    let i ← s.n - 1#usize
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize s.idx i
    if i1 = index
    then
      let a ← Array.index_usize s.val i
      let b ←
        core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 a leaf
      if b
      then ok (some s)
      else ok none
    else
      let a ← Array.update s.idx s.n index
      let a1 ← Array.update s.val s.n leaf
      let i2 ← s.n + 1#usize
      ok (some { s with idx := a, val := a1, n := i2 })
  else
    let a ← Array.update s.idx s.n index
    let a1 ← Array.update s.val s.n leaf
    let i ← s.n + 1#usize
    ok (some { s with idx := a, val := a1, n := i })

def reference.canonical_word (b : Array Std.U8 4#usize) : Result Bool := do
  let i ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b)
  ok (i < 2147483647#u32)

def reference.canonical_qm (b : Array Std.U8 16#usize) : Result Bool := do
  let i ← Array.index_usize b 0#usize
  let i1 ← Array.index_usize b 1#usize
  let i2 ← Array.index_usize b 2#usize
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize b 3#usize
  let b1 ← reference.canonical_word (Array.make 4#usize [ i, i1, i2, i3 ])
  if b1
  then
    let i4 ← Array.index_usize b 4#usize
    let i5 ← Array.index_usize b 5#usize
    let i6 ← Array.index_usize b 6#usize
    let i7 ← Array.index_usize b 7#usize
    let b2 ← reference.canonical_word (Array.make 4#usize [ i4, i5, i6, i7 ])
    if b2
    then
      let i8 ← Array.index_usize b 8#usize
      let i9 ← Array.index_usize b 9#usize
      let i10 ← Array.index_usize b 10#usize
      let i11 ← Array.index_usize b 11#usize
      let b3 ←
        reference.canonical_word (Array.make 4#usize [ i8, i9, i10, i11 ])
      if b3
      then
        let i12 ← Array.index_usize b 12#usize
        let i13 ← Array.index_usize b 13#usize
        let i14 ← Array.index_usize b 14#usize
        let i15 ← Array.index_usize b 15#usize
        reference.canonical_word (Array.make 4#usize [ i12, i13, i14, i15 ])
      else ok false
    else ok false
  else ok false

/-- [aspis_multiproof_cone::reference::row_shape]:
    Source: 'src/reference.rs', lines 64:0-68:1
    Visibility: public -/
def reference.row_shape
  (row : Std.U8) : Result (Option (Std.U8 × Std.Usize)) := do
  if row >= 27#u8
  then ok none
  else
    if row = 2#u8
    then ok (some (1#u8, 32#usize))
    else
      if row = 14#u8
      then ok (some (3#u8, 32#usize))
      else
        if row >= 15#u8
        then
          if row <= 24#u8
          then ok (some (2#u8, 896#usize))
          else
            if row = 25#u8
            then ok (some (4#u8, 3712#usize))
            else
              if row = 26#u8
              then ok (some (5#u8, 928#usize))
              else ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
        else
          if row = 25#u8
          then ok (some (4#u8, 3712#usize))
          else
            if row = 26#u8
            then ok (some (5#u8, 928#usize))
            else ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))

/-- [aspis_multiproof_cone::reference::semantic_offsets]:
    Source: 'src/reference.rs', lines 70:0-75:1
    Visibility: public -/
def reference.semantic_offsets
  (row : Std.U8) (src : Std.Usize) (dst : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Option (Std.Usize × Std.Usize))
  := do
  if row >= 27#u8
  then ok (some (src, dst))
  else
    let o ← reference.row_shape row
    let cf ← core.option.Option.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitTry.branch o
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let (_, size) := val
      let stored ← if row >= 14#u8
                     then size / 2#usize
                     else ok size
      let i ← row + 1#u8
      let i1 ← src + 5#usize
      let i2 ← i1 + stored
      let i3 ← dst + 5#usize
      let i4 ← i3 + size
      reference.semantic_offsets i i2 i4
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.option.Option.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualOptionInfallible.from_residual
        (Std.Usize × Std.Usize) residual
partial_fixpoint

/-- [aspis_multiproof_cone::reference::check_values]:
    Source: 'src/reference.rs', lines 77:0-81:1
    Visibility: public -/
def reference.check_values (bytes : Slice Std.U8) : Result Bool := do
  let i := Slice.len bytes
  if i < 16#usize
  then ok true
  else
    let chunk ← reference.read16 bytes
    let b ← reference.canonical_qm chunk
    if b
    then
      let s ←
        core.slice.index.Slice.index
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) bytes
          { start := 16#usize }
      reference.check_values s
    else ok false
partial_fixpoint

/-- [aspis_multiproof_cone::reference::expand_rows]:
    Source: 'src/reference.rs', lines 82:0-88:1
    Visibility: public -/
def reference.expand_rows
  (bytes : Slice Std.U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) :
  Result (Option (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
  := do
  let b ← core.slice.Slice.is_empty bytes
  if b
  then ok (some out)
  else
    let i := Slice.len bytes
    if i < 16#usize
    then ok none
    else
      let chunk ← reference.read16 bytes
      let a ← reference.expand_chunk chunk
      let s ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
      let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out s
      let s1 ←
        core.slice.index.Slice.index
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) bytes
          { start := 16#usize }
      reference.expand_rows s1 out1
partial_fixpoint
